liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **You Can Be Your Silhouette**: rare: 8 archived performances [8]
- **The Great Chain of Being**: back after 25 archived shows (433 days) [8]
- **Slow Jam I**: back after 26 archived shows (436 days); rare: 4 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-08-17.mysteryjackofficial** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 180 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Limited vocals allow listeners to sink into the jam [7]
- **kglw2024-08-17.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 24 songs; 179 min [2]
- **kglw2024-08-17**: source not stated; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Ambrose crowd surfed on an inflatable gator while singing this song [4]
- Amby crowd surfed on an inflatable croc wearing a borrowed cowboy hat [5]
- This was Marathon Show Night 2 at the venue [2]
- Band's style resembles late 1960s and early 1970s rock [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-08-17.mysteryjackofficial**: taped by @mysteryjackofficial; transferred by @mysteryjackofficial; source: Source: AUD- Church Audio CA14 Cardioid Microphones> Roland R-07 Digital Recorder @ 24bit/48kHz WAV- ORTF- Stand mounted dead center in front of the soundboard… [1]
- **kglw2024-08-17.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph; source: SBD [2]. Also: Recorded by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, and Grace [2]
- **kglw2024-08-17**: taped by Rich Cuiffo; transferred by Rich Cuiffo; source: Schoeps MK41s > Nbob Actives > Zoom F3 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Teesmithy: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Tour In Forest Hills NY On Aug 17 2024 Poster Canvas - Teesmithy](https://teesmithy.com/products/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-tour-in-forest-hills-ny-on-aug-17-2024-poster-canvas/) [9]
